name: Distributed Diffusion Inference: Ring Attention & LCM Distillation
tagline: Scale 243K-token Diffusion Transformers across NVLink GPU rings while cutting denoising steps from 50 to 4–8.
purpose: Overcome single-GPU HBM limits and multi-second denoising latency for high-resolution image and 1080p video diffusion models.

spark.summary: Ring Attention shards long spatio-temporal DiT token sequences across an NVLink GPU ring, overlapping P2P KV transfers with FP8 FlashAttention compute, while LCM distillation reduces denoising from 50 steps to 4–8.
spark.keyTakeaway: If model quality drifts from offline training baselines, pairing Context Parallelism (Ring Attention) with 4–8 step Latent Consistency Model (LCM) distillation and TinyVAE latent previews cuts 1080p video and image generation latency by 6x–10x.
spark.byteSummary:
Modern Diffusion Transformers (DiT) for high-resolution images and 1080p video operate on massive spatio-temporal token sequences—up to 243,000 tokens for a multi-second 1080p clip. Computing full self-attention across 243K tokens on a single GPU exceeds 80 GB HBM and stalls inference for minutes.

**Ring Attention (Context Parallelism)** partitions the 243K token sequence evenly across 8 GPUs connected over high-bandwidth NVLink (900 GB/s). Each GPU holds `N/P` query tokens and passes Key-Value (KV) blocks peer-to-peer around the ring, overlapping the 0.41 ms NVLink transfer with 5.21 ms of FP8 FlashAttention-3 compute using online softmax accumulation.

To slash end-to-end wall-clock time further, **Latent Consistency Model (LCM) distillation** collapses 50 iterative denoising steps into 4–8 steps, while a lightweight **TinyVAE** decodes intermediate latents asynchronously at steps 1, 2, 4, and 8 to stream ~18 ms progressive WebP previews to the user.

learningJourney.title: Why 1080p Video DiTs Exceed Single-GPU HBM
learningJourney.purpose: Shard 243K-token 1080p video DiT sequences across 8 GPUs because single-GPU HBM cannot hold full attention matrices.

explanation.foundation: A 5-second 1080p video at 24 fps compressed 8x spatially and 4x temporally yields ~243,000 latent patch tokens.
explanation.core: Materializing an unsharded `243K x 243K` attention score matrix in FP16 would require > 118 GB per head—far beyond an 80 GB HBM3 GPU.

learningJourney.title: Overlapping P2P NVLink KV Transfers with FP8 FlashAttention
learningJourney.purpose: Overlap peer-to-peer NVLink KV shard transfers with FP8 FlashAttention-3 compute across the 8-GPU ring.

explanation.foundation: Each of the 8 GPUs holds `1/8` of the Q, K, V sequence (`~30.4K` tokens). In step `s` of the ring, GPU `i` computes local FlashAttention-3 against its current KV shard while asynchronously sending that KV shard to GPU `(i + 1) % 8` over NVLink.
explanation.core: Because compute (5.21 ms) exceeds NVLink transfer (0.41 ms), communication is 100% hidden behind compute.

learningJourney.title: Combining Partial Ring Attention Blocks via Online Softmax
learningJourney.purpose: Combine partial attention outputs across ring steps exactly using online softmax log-sum-exp rescaling.

explanation.core:
def update_online_softmax(acc_out, acc_lse, block_out, block_lse):
    """Exact FlashAttention / RingAttention running log-sum-exp merge."""
    if acc_out is None:
        return block_out, block_lse
    new_lse = max(acc_lse, block_lse) + math.log1p(math.exp(-abs(acc_lse - block_lse)))
    w_acc = math.exp(acc_lse - new_lse)
    w_blk = math.exp(block_lse - new_lse)
    merged = [w_acc * a + w_blk * b for a, b in zip(acc_out, block_out)]
    return merged, new_lse
```

learningJourney.title: 4–8 Step LCM Distillation & CFG Batching
learningJourney.purpose: Cut diffusion forward passes from 50 steps to 4-8 steps using LCM distillation and batched CFG.

explanation.core: Standard DDIM/Euler diffusion needs 30–50 sequential forward passes, and Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) doubles batch compute (conditional + unconditional). **LCM / Consistency Distillation** maps noisy latents directly toward the ODE trajectory endpoint in 4–8 steps, while **CFG distillation** folds guidance into a single pass.

learningJourney.title: Non-Blocking TinyVAE Latent Previews over SSE
learningJourney.purpose: Stream progressive WebP previews at steps 1, 2, 4, and 8 using a non-blocking TinyVAE side stream.

explanation.foundation: Think of **Non-Blocking TinyVAE Latent Previews over SSE** as the intuition layer for Distributed Diffusion Inference: Ring Attention & LCM Distillation: Stream progressive WebP previews at steps 1, 2, 4, and 8 using a non-blocking TinyVAE side stream.

learningJourney.title: NVLink Ring Desync, Spot Preemption & Latent Checkpointing
learningJourney.purpose: Survive spot GPU preemptions and NVLink ring desyncs using 2-step latent checkpoints on NVMe/Redis.

explanation.foundation: Think of **NVLink Ring Desync, Spot Preemption & Latent Checkpointing** as the intuition layer for Distributed Diffusion Inference: Ring Attention & LCM Distillation: Survive spot GPU preemptions and NVLink ring desyncs using 2-step latent checkpoints on NVMe/Redis.

Generating high-res video takes too much memory for a single GPU. Ring Attention splits the video tokens across 8 linked GPUs that pass data in a circle while working.

Meanwhile, LCM distillation cuts the number of passes from 50 down to 4–8, and TinyVAE streams quick draft previews.
